drafts.angle: Community-service explainer; avoid presenting statewide football as core city coverage
drafts.subject: A small audience-specific script pilot for Mirror Indy
drafts.body:
Hello Mirror Indy team,

We are testing Media Maker, an editorial planning tool for adapting a supplied story into a short script, written companion and source checklist. Your community-centred Indianapolis coverage makes a practical local-service explainer a useful test case.

Would an editor be open to reviewing a tightly scoped pilot using source material you select? Your team retains editorial control. Automated finished video is not part of this offer.

You can see the workflow and request a pilot at https://thebotstores.com/pages/media-maker. Scope, delivery date and price would be agreed before any purchase.

If this is not relevant, let us know and we will not follow up.

Mel Banks II
The Bot Stores

drafts.angle: Black Chicago context and editorial ownership
drafts.subject: A Chicago audience-tuning pilot for your editorial desk
drafts.body:
Hello The TRiiBE team,

We are building Media Maker to help organise a supplied story into an audience-specific script, written companion and source ledger. For your Black Chicago readership, I would propose testing how a local arts or community story can carry the same verified facts across a short script and written edition while preserving your voice and context.

Would your editorial team consider reviewing one scoped planning pilot? You choose the source story and retain editorial approval. We are not offering automatic published reporting or finished video at this stage.

The working sample and enquiry route are at https://thebotstores.com/pages/media-maker. We would agree the scope and price before purchase.

If this is not useful, tell us and we will not follow up.

Mel Banks II
The Bot Stores

drafts.angle: Community radio and language-access planning; translation not sold
drafts.subject: A community-radio planning pilot for MEDIALEX
drafts.body:
Hello MEDIALEX team,

Your community-created radio and multilingual mission suggest a useful test for Media Maker: one short radio script and written companion built from material your team supplies, with clear audience and pronunciation notes.

We can also record the requirements for a future language edition, while keeping translation production outside this initial pilot. Your qualified local reviewers would retain editorial and language approval.

Would you consider evaluating one scoped English-language planning pilot? The sample and request route are at https://thebotstores.com/pages/media-maker. Scope, schedule and price would be confirmed before purchase.

If this is not relevant, let us know and we will not follow up.

Mel Banks II
The Bot Stores
